sources.title: Complete Primate Skeleton from the Middle Eocene of Messel in Germany: Morphology and Paleobiology

preservation_clarifications.Pelvis and posterior limb: Plate A preserves only a short proximal left lower-limb fragment beyond the knee; the distal left lower leg and foot must not be completed. Complete right lower leg and foot are retained.
preservation_clarifications.Vertebral column: Ca1-Ca3 bear strong transverse processes, Ca4 has a reduced process near its caudal end, and Ca5 onward lack transverse processes.
